title: Faithful Evaluation of Semantic-ID Tokenizers for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2605.25330v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative recommendation based on Semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a discrete sequence of SIDs and is conventionally evaluated by matching the generated SID sequence against the target item's SID sequence. This evaluation is faithful only when each SID sequence uniquely identifies one item. In practice, SID collisions violate this condition: across the evaluated SID tokenizers and datasets, collision rates reach 30.52%, and SID-level Hit@10 is inflated by up to 103.36% relative to item-level Hit@10. To address this evaluation gap, we introduce Collision-Corrected Evaluation (CCE), which defines collision-aware item-level metrics (ItemHit@K, ItemNDCG@K) computed from generated SID sequences, and Zero-Collision Reassignment (ZCR), which constructs zero-collision SID assignments for existing tokenizers via minimum-cost reassignment. translated_title: 语义ID分词器在生成式推荐中的忠实评估
translated_abstract: 基于语义ID（SIDs）的生成式推荐将每个物品表示为SID的离散序列，通常通过将生成的SID序列与目标物品的SID序列进行匹配来评估。这种评估只有在每个SID序列唯一标识一个物品时才是忠实的。在实践中，SID碰撞违反了这一条件：在评估的SID分词器和数据集中，碰撞率高达30.52%，而SID级别的Hit@10相对于物品级别的Hit@10被夸大了高达103.36%。为了解决这一评估差距，我们引入了碰撞校正评估（CCE），它定义了从生成的SID序列计算出的碰撞感知的物品级指标（ItemHit@K, ItemNDCG@K），以及零碰撞重新分配（ZCR），它通过最小成本重新分配为现有分词器构建零碰撞的SID分配。将这些方法应用于四个数据集和五个代表性SID分词器，我们发现
tldr: 本文提出碰撞校正评估和零碰撞重新分配方法，解决语义ID分词器在生成式推荐中因SID碰撞导致的评估不忠实问题，显著修正了评估指标偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Collision-Corrected Evaluation and Zero-Collision Reassignment to address unfaithful evaluation in generative recommendation caused by Semantic-ID collisions, significantly correcting metric inflation.
